build_transformer_lm_model: build a TransformerLanguageModel instance using build_model with args and task for language modeling
build_transformer_lm_embedding: build an Embedding token lookup table using build_embedding with dictionary and embed_dim
list_transformer_lm_hub_models: list available pretrained TransformerLanguageModel hub models and their download URLs
register_transformer_lm_gpt3_architectur: register a GPT-3 sized transformer_lm architecture like gpt3_small or gpt3_175
configure_transformer_lm_dataclass: configure TransformerLanguageModelConfig with decoder layers, embed dim, dropout, and activation settings
